name: Prone Y-Raise
steps: Lie face down with your forehead supported and reach your arms diagonally forward into a Y shape.
Turn your thumbs upward and brace your abdomen while keeping your ribs against the floor.
Lift both hands a little off the floor with straight elbows, then lower them slowly to the start.
tips: Reach long through your fingertips instead of lifting your chin.
Stop lifting before you need to arch your back or shrug.
